sections.Profile:
"Black Gold" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. on March 12, 1949. Designed by Harvey Heiss, the game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Energy, Oil, Wood Rail, Original Theme
